name: label

frames.best_why: Filled email, caption, helper line and the bright focus ring are all visible at once.

tagline: Small bold caption above a dark field that rings when focused.
summary: A form label in small bold type sits above an email input and a line of helper text. Focusing the field swaps its faint border for a bright ring.
appearance: A short bold white caption, 'Email address', above a rounded dark input holding a grey placeholder, with a dim single-line helper note below. When focused, the field's edge becomes a bright thin ring.
behaviour: The caption itself never moves. Focusing the field below turns its faint outline into a bright ring, and typed characters replace the placeholder one at a time.
demo_content: Caption 'Email address', placeholder you@example.com, and the note We'll never share your email with anyone else.
search_phrases: small bold caption for a field
short hint under an email box
use_when: Every form field needs a visible caption tied to its control for sighted users and screen readers.
avoid_when: Only the caption is styled; the input, placeholder and helper line are demo markup you must build.
customise: Pass the caption as children and point htmlFor at the field id; restyle with className. Type size, weight and the disabled fade are fixed in the file.
weight_why: One styled text element from a Radix primitive; no animation or script of its own.

a11y.note: The primitive writes a real label element tied to the control by htmlFor; the focus ring and layout come from the demo markup.

issues: Helper line is very low contrast against the near-black stage.
polish_why: Tidy spacing and a clear focus ring, but the helper text is faint and styling is standard.
title: Form Label
